rubric_content.text_property: Every committed claim in the curated memory carries an explicit source (which imbiber / file / signal it came from) — there is no uncited claim, and nothing is asserted that the imbibed sources do not support.

rubrics.description: Groundedness track: the company's memory is always source-cited; an uncited claim must never be committed.

rubric_content.text_property: The curated memory is internally non-contradictory: it does not assert a fact and its negation, nor two different values for the same fact. A contradictory claim set is rolled back rather than committed.

rubrics.description: Groundedness track: a self-contradicting memory can never be committed (groundedness is gated to 0.0).

rubric_content.text_property: When the question is out-of-corpus (no imbibed source supports it), the answer is an explicit REFUSAL with empty citations — it never fabricates an answer in the founder's voice. When in-corpus, it answers and cites the source.

rubrics.description: Refusal track: the out-of-corpus refusal is the contract that keeps the company from being bound by a hallucinated founder opinion.
